description: This file contains the implementation of the AuthHelper class responsible for managing authentication processes within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for authenticating users, logging out, synchronizing user data, updating passwords, and loading authentication modules dynamically using ServiceLoader. The class interacts with external Authenticator interfaces and utilizes security privileges for class loading.

classes.name: AuthHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing authentication lifecycle such as login, logout, synchronization, and password updates in the framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Verifies user credentials by delegating to multiple authenticators and returning true if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the specified user from all loaded authenticators.

methods.name: syncUser
methods.description: Synchronizes user information across authenticators if supported.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password across all authenticators capable of such an operation.

methods.name: authenticatorsLoaded
methods.description: Checks whether authenticators have been successfully loaded.

methods.name: loadAuthenticators
methods.description: Initializes and loads authenticators via the ServiceLoader, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: loadAuthenticatorsInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal process of loading, initializing, and sorting authenticators.

methods.name: getContextClassLoader
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's context class loader with privileged access.
